missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Смысл' is masculine nominative as the subject in this existential phrase. 'Глубокий' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Смысл' is the masculine inanimate accusative, identical to the nominative. It is the object of 'понимаю', and 'фразы' is genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive in negation. 'Смысла' is the masculine genitive required after 'нет'. 'Никакого' agrees in the masculine genitive, denying any sense.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of content. 'Смыслом' is the instrumental form naming what the book is filled with. A natural figurative phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О смысле' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Жизни' is the genitive, naming the meaning of life.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in an idiom. 'В смысле' uses the prepositional form in the set phrase 'в прямом смысле', meaning literally. A useful discourse marker.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Смысл' is the masculine accusative object of 'придаёт'. 'Работе' is the dative recipient of the new meaning.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Смыслы' is the masculine nominative plural as the subject. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, naming different meanings.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Смысла' is the masculine genitive after 'без'. The sentence states that words are empty without meaning.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Смысл' is masculine nominative as the subject of the rhetorical question. 'Какой' agrees in the masculine.
